sources.title: Reference conversation: 의학물 용어 정리
sources.supported_scope: 19 sections, 24 tables, 346 term rows and 8 combinations; original request includes appearance, sexual and violent subjects.
sources.claim_limit: Seed scope only. The conversation is not a clinical authority; grouped terms remain grouped.

sources.title: OpenStax: Positioning in Bed
sources.supported_scope: Bed positioning distinguishes back, abdomen, side, semiprone and elevated-backrest configurations; pillows and wedges provide support.
sources.claim_limit: Clinical positioning instructions are not being prescribed. Geometry of each proposed photograph is authored.

sources.title: OpenStax: Intraoperative Considerations
sources.supported_scope: Table 26.4 distinguishes lithotomy, whole-table tilt, knee-chest and jackknife; surrounding sections describe surgical attire and time-out.
sources.claim_limit: Three small diagrams were visually inspected: lithotomy, Trendelenburg and reverse Trendelenburg. Other images and all procedure correctness remain unqualified.

sources.title: MedlinePlus: Physical examination
sources.supported_scope: Inspection, palpation, percussion and auscultation name different examination methods.
sources.claim_limit: A still image can depict a hand or instrument position, not the sound heard or the examination result.

sources.title: FDA: Medical Gowns
sources.supported_scope: Surgical and isolation gowns have different intended uses and protection zones; surgical gowns are supplied sterile.
sources.claim_limit: Color, folds or apparent cleanliness do not establish sterile status, barrier rating or product classification.

sources.title: FDA: N95 respirators and surgical masks
sources.supported_scope: N95 respirators are designed for a close facial fit; surgical masks are loose fitting.
sources.claim_limit: Appearance cannot establish certification, filtration performance or a successful fit test.

sources.title: CDC: Isolation precautions recommendations
sources.supported_scope: Protective clothing and gloves are selected for contact and exposure circumstances, with contamination management.
sources.claim_limit: A photograph cannot certify compliance throughout a sequence or identify an infectious organism.

sources.title: CDC: Environmental infection control, Air
sources.supported_scope: Airborne isolation and protective environments have different pressure directions.
sources.claim_limit: Closed doors or glass are not evidence of measured air pressure or flow. A diagram represents a claim only.

sources.title: RadiologyInfo: Body CT
sources.supported_scope: CT uses X-ray information to construct cross-sectional images.
sources.claim_limit: Device silhouette varies by model. A scan image alone does not prove diagnosis, scanner operation or patient ownership.

sources.title: RadiologyInfo: Body MRI
sources.supported_scope: MRI uses magnetic fields and radiofrequency rather than X-rays; device and clothing screening matter.
sources.claim_limit: Do not infer model-specific bore dimensions or universal metal compatibility from this overview.

sources.title: RadiologyInfo: General Ultrasound
sources.supported_scope: Ultrasound uses sound waves; Doppler adds information about motion such as blood flow.
sources.claim_limit: Probe contact and screen contents do not prove organ identity, pregnancy, fetal viability or blood flow.

sources.title: FDA: Pulse Oximeter Basics
sources.supported_scope: Pulse oximeters estimate blood oxygen saturation; accuracy can vary with pigmentation, circulation and other factors.
sources.claim_limit: A displayed number is not an independently verified physiological measurement. Skin color must not be used as a diagnosis shortcut.

sources.title: NHS: Intensive care
sources.supported_scope: ICU equipment includes separate monitoring, ventilation, IV pumps, feeding tubes and drainage; planned postoperative care also occurs.
sources.claim_limit: ICU does not imply impending death or a particular consciousness state; not every patient uses every device.

sources.title: NHLBI: What is a ventilator?
sources.supported_scope: Ventilation can use a fitted mask or an airway tube connected to a breathing circuit.
sources.claim_limit: Visible external connections do not establish correct internal placement, settings, gas exchange or treatment success.

sources.title: Alfred Hospital: ECMO circuit components
sources.supported_scope: An ECMO circuit separates pump, oxygenator, tubing, drainage and return cannula functions.
sources.claim_limit: Local educational guidance. A generic red tube is insufficient to identify ECMO; exact VA/VV configuration requires a specific reference.

sources.title: NIDDK: Hemodialysis
sources.supported_scope: Blood is routed through an external dialyzer and returned; a common access example uses two arm needles.
sources.claim_limit: This does not define CRRT device geometry or every vascular access variant.

sources.title: AHA: 2025 Adult Cardiac Arrest Algorithm, accessible description
sources.supported_scope: The algorithm separates VF/pulseless VT from asystole/PEA and directs shocks through the shockable branch.
sources.claim_limit: No treatment instruction or rhythm diagnosis is produced here. A still pose cannot show compression rate, recoil or successful resuscitation.

sources.title: WHO: Surgical Safety Checklist tools
sources.supported_scope: The checklist supports team communication and surgical safety checks.
sources.claim_limit: A clipboard or paused team does not prove identity verification, consent or completion of the checklist.

sources.title: AHRQ: SBAR
sources.supported_scope: SBAR structures clinical communication into situation, background, assessment and recommendation.
sources.claim_limit: Two people talking cannot establish the spoken content or that SBAR was followed.

sources.title: AHRQ: Handoff
sources.supported_scope: Handoff transfers patient-care information, authority and responsibility at transitions.
sources.claim_limit: Passing a chart is only a visible proxy; actual responsibility transfer is nonvisual.

sources.title: GMC: Intimate examinations and chaperones
sources.supported_scope: Explanation, permission to stop, consent or valid authority, privacy and the offered chaperone role are distinct considerations.
sources.claim_limit: UK professional guidance is not a universal law. Presence, clothing, silence or a signature cannot prove consent or chaperone qualification.

sources.title: WMA: International Code of Medical Ethics
sources.supported_scope: The accessible official search excerpt establishes the code's ethics and nondiscrimination scope.
sources.claim_limit: Full text could not be fetched. No paragraph-specific current-patient prohibition is claimed from this access; use GMC or a future full-text review.

sources.title: ACOG: Pelvic Exams
sources.supported_scope: A speculum examination is one part of pelvic examination; the term does not mean every type of internal examination.
sources.claim_limit: No fixed examination sequence or universal indication is inferred. Exact instrument variants need plate review.

sources.title: WHO: Compendium on respectful maternal and newborn care
sources.supported_scope: The 2025 publication describes dignity, protection from mistreatment and informed choices in maternal and newborn care.
sources.claim_limit: Overview only; the full compendium and local legal definitions were not read. Mistreatment cannot be diagnosed from a still image.

sources.title: US DOJ OVW: SAFE information
sources.supported_scope: SAFE combines medical history, examination, injury care, documentation and evidence sample collection.
sources.claim_limit: A kit, injury or examiner's appearance cannot prove assault, perpetrator identity or uninterrupted chain of custody.

sources.title: WHO: Palliative care
sources.supported_scope: Palliative care addresses physical, psychological, social and practical suffering and can begin early.
sources.claim_limit: A quiet room or hand-holding does not establish terminal illness, hospice eligibility or time to death.

sources.title: NHS: DNACPR decisions
sources.supported_scope: DNACPR concerns attempted CPR and does not mean all appropriate treatment and support stop.
sources.claim_limit: UK explanation; document wording or legal applicability elsewhere requires local review.

sources.title: WHO: Rehabilitation
sources.supported_scope: Rehabilitation addresses functioning and can follow injury, surgery, illness or age-related change.
sources.claim_limit: An assistive device cannot establish a diagnosis, permanence of impairment or a completed recovery trajectory.

sources.title: AAOS: Care of Casts and Splints
sources.supported_scope: A cast encloses a limb; a splint has a partial rigid support that can accommodate swelling; padding and fixation are distinct.
sources.claim_limit: A chosen appearance does not establish correct application, healing or actual material composition.

sources.title: MedlinePlus: Blue discoloration of the skin
sources.supported_scope: Cyanosis can affect skin and mucosa; visibility varies by skin tone and observation site.
sources.claim_limit: Blue lighting is not cyanosis. A visual proxy cannot establish oxygenation or cause.

sources.title: MedlinePlus: Paleness
sources.supported_scope: Paleness differs from pigment loss and varies with baseline coloration and observation site.
sources.claim_limit: A fair complexion alone is not pallor or anemia; comparative baseline is usually absent.

sources.title: MedlinePlus: Jaundice
sources.supported_scope: Yellow discoloration can involve skin and sclera and has multiple causes.
sources.claim_limit: Warm color grading alone is insufficient; no particular liver disease is inferred.

sources.title: NCI: Nutrition in Cancer Care PDQ
sources.supported_scope: Cancer-related nutrition and muscle loss require clinical context; body size alone is an incomplete proxy.
sources.claim_limit: The full long review was not exhaustively reviewed; thinness does not establish cachexia or cancer.

sources.title: NCI: Remission
sources.supported_scope: Complete remission can coexist with remaining cancer; remission is not automatic proof of cure.
sources.claim_limit: A scan, smile, regrown hair or a discharge paper cannot prove remission.

sources.title: NIMH: Understanding Psychosis
sources.supported_scope: Psychosis is a collection of experiences and symptoms including hallucinations and delusions.
sources.claim_limit: Appearance cannot diagnose psychosis, assign a violent disposition or prove another person's perception.

sources.title: NIMH: Brain Stimulation Therapies
sources.supported_scope: Modern ECT involves anesthesia and a muscle relaxant.
sources.claim_limit: Electrode pads do not establish treatment type, mental state, consent or effective dosing.

sources.title: OpenStax: Wound Classification
sources.supported_scope: Abrasion, incision, contusion, laceration, puncture, avulsion and pressure injury are distinct descriptions.
sources.claim_limit: Surface morphology does not identify weapon, intent, timing, infection or the cause of death.

sources.title: Science Museum Group: Complete nurse's uniform
sources.supported_scope: The English 1930-1940 composite includes striped dress, starched apron, collar, cuffs, cap, belt and shoes; component dates vary.
sources.claim_limit: Catalogue, not garment pixels. Composite items probably came from different uniforms; not a universal historical uniform.

sources.title: Science Museum Group: Elizabeth Batten uniform collection
sources.supported_scope: A 1910-1920 grey wool shoulder cape with red felt edging belongs to a specified nursing collection.
sources.claim_limit: Do not merge it into the 1930-1940 composite as one documented ensemble. Material is catalogue provenance, not pixel inference.

sources.title: Harlequin: Medical Romance series submissions
sources.supported_scope: This publisher's series centers a romantic relationship integrated with medical coworkers and their work.
sources.claim_limit: One publisher's editorial requirements are not a universal genre definition or a visual test for romance.

sources.title: Fanlore: Sickfic
sources.supported_scope: Fandom usage centers illness, often involving care by another character.
sources.claim_limit: Community usage only; the full article was inaccessible and no clinical meaning is supplied.

sources.title: Fanlore: Whump
sources.supported_scope: The fandom page records a term related to hurt/comfort, suffering and sickfic.
sources.claim_limit: Not a fixed injury morphology or an instruction to add gore; full article unavailable.

sources.title: Oxford Academic: referenced medical-fetish chapter
sources.supported_scope: Reference-conversation bibliographic lead only.
sources.claim_limit: Non-retryable redirect error; neither chapter nor abstract was read. Never an evidence anchor.

sources.title: OpenStax: Cardiopulmonary management
sources.supported_scope: Oxygen devices and respiratory assessment are differentiated in the device table and examination section.
sources.claim_limit: Flow rates and treatment settings are outside this visual research; avoid importing them into generated scenes.

sources.title: OpenStax: Nursing Management of Elimination
sources.supported_scope: Urinary drainage, bladder assessment and dialysis are separate processes and device arrangements.
sources.claim_limit: No universal catheter insertion method or complete drainage setup is inferred from an overview.

sources.title: KTAS official: 한국형 응급환자 분류도구
sources.supported_scope: The Korean tool has five urgency levels used to prioritize emergency care.
sources.claim_limit: The color of a wristband does not prove a KTAS level; disaster triage tags are not interchangeable with KTAS.

sources.title: CDC: About Sepsis
sources.supported_scope: Sepsis is a life-threatening response to infection that may lead to tissue and organ damage.
sources.claim_limit: Sweat, pallor, tubes or a red rash do not prove sepsis or its source.

sources.title: NIGMS: Anesthesia
sources.supported_scope: Anesthesia can be administered by several routes and differs by intended extent and effect.
sources.claim_limit: Closed eyes or a mask do not prove anesthesia depth, analgesia, paralysis or awareness.

sources.title: NCBI Open RN: Nursing Assistant, personal care
sources.supported_scope: Catheter-care checklist warns against kinks and elevation that permit backflow.
sources.claim_limit: Only the search excerpt was reviewed; retain exact drainage-bag geometry for subsequent device-reference review.

sources.title: Fanlore: Hurt/Comfort
sources.supported_scope: Named in the reference conversation and related accessible fandom excerpts.
sources.claim_limit: Direct page returned 403. Use reference-conversation provenance only for this exact entry until verified.
